items.label: 【Material
items.value: 】This 3/4 sleeve floral top is made of 95% polyester and 5% spandex. It is lightweight, soft, breathable, and suitable for summer, spring, and fall wear. Tips: Some of the full-print patterns are random and may not be the same as the pictures.

items.label: 【Features
items.value: 3/4 length sleeve shirts for women, fall tops dressy casual, women's fall fashion trendy clothes, adorable pleated front design, multiple boho floral outfits, cute curved hemline to hide the tummy, making the blouses suitable for any body shape.

items.label: 【Match
items.value: 】This three quarter sleeve blouse is very versatile and can be worn dressed up or casually. You can wear it alone with skirts, shorts, jeans in cool weather,such as summer spring, or pair it with a cardigan, flannel jacket, leather skirt, suit pants, high heels for a autumn fall chic look.

items.label: 【Occasion
items.value: 】The dressy tops for women are perfect for daily wear, casual work, office, business, parties, dates, clubs, country concerts, night out with friends, going out, school, holiday, vacation, travel, beach and any occasion. Also,this blouse would be a great gift for your wife, mom, or teacher whom you care about.

items.label: 【Garment Care
items.value: 】Machine wash cold, hand wash recommended, dry on low heat or hang dry, iron on low. Please note: These blouses are vacuum-packed and may wrinkle when unpacked. Simply wash and iron to remove wrinkles and maintain their pristine appearance.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine wash, Hand wash, Tumble dry

items.value: Machine wash, Hand wash, Tumble dry
